task_meta.downstream_task: Alzheimer's disease detection using Cookie Theft picture-description task recordings
task_meta.goal: Keep the spoken content and evaluate all methods to summarize what works for this task.

request: ADReSS is an English Alzheimer's disease dataset derived from the Pitt corpus, comprising recordings from 156 participants aged 50--79 years. The official split contains 54 HC and 54 AD participants for training, and 24 HC and 24 AD participants for testing. All recordings correspond to the Cookie Theft picture-description task. Keep the spoken content and evaluate all methods to summarize what works for this task.
reflections: NeuralVC: The user requests anonymization of English ADReSS recordings, explicitly asks to skip content masking, and asks to run all methods. The system prompt calls for one initial method, so I chose NeuralVC as a representative learned conversion method, followed by evaluation.
